008679: // The constant rows every integer literal becomes, taking the source range

008681: // declaration's range.
008682: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_emit_integer_value_at(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, u64 value, bool is_negative, IrSourceRange instruction_source,
008683:                                                        IrTypeId type)
008684: {

008687:     immediate[0] = value;
008688:     IrInstruction instruction = c_ir_instruction_initialize(IR_OPCODE_CONSTANT_INTEGER, type);
008689:     instruction.immediates = immediate;
008690:     instruction.immediate_count = 1;
008691:     instruction.immediate_is_negative = is_negative;
008692:     instruction.result = result;
008693:     IrInstructionId id = c_ir_append_instruction(builder, instruction, instruction_source);
008694:     builder->function->values[result.value].definition = id;
008695:     return result;
008696: }

008718: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL CArrayBound c_ir_vla_bound_expression(CPreprocessResult preprocess, CArrayBound bound)
008719: {
008720:     u32 end = bound.token_start + bound.token_count;
008721:     while (bound.token_start < end)
008722:     {
008723:         CToken token = preprocess.tokens[bound.token_start];
008724:         bool qualifier = token.kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER && (string_equal(c_token_spelling(preprocess.spelling_base, token), S8("static")) || string_equal(c_token_spelling(preprocess.spelling_base, token), S8("const")) ||
008725:                                                               string_equal(c_token_spelling(preprocess.spelling_base, token), S8("volatile")) || string_equal(c_token_spelling(preprocess.spelling_base, token), S8("restrict")));
008726:         if (!qualifier)
008727:         {
008728:             break;
008729:         }
008730:         bound.token_start += 1;
008731:     }
008732:     bound.token_count = end - bound.token_start;
008733:     return bound;
008734: }

008739: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_integer_literal_fits(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CTypeKind kind, u64 value)
008740: {
008741:     u64 limit = builder->literal_limits[kind];
008742:     if (limit)
008743:     {
008744:         return value <= limit;
008745:     }
008746:     IrTypeId type = builder->scalar_types[kind];
008747:     IrType* integer = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, type);
008748:     bool result;
008749:     if (!integer || integer->kind != IR_TYPE_INTEGER)
008750:     {
008751:         result = false;
008752:     }
008753:     else if (integer->bit_width >= 64)
008754:     {
008755:         result = !integer->is_signed || value <= INT64_MAX;
008756:     }
008757:     else if (!integer->is_signed)
008758:     {
008759:         result = value <= (((u64)1 << integer->bit_width) - 1);
008760:     }
008761:     else
008762:     {
008763:         result = value <= (((u64)1 << (integer->bit_width - 1)) - 1);
008764:     }
008765: 
008766:     return result;
008767: }

008769: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrTypeId c_ir_integer_literal_type(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, String8 spelling, u64 value)
008770: {
008771:     IrTypeId result = IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
008772:     bool suffix_valid = true;

008781:     }

008783:     {

008785:         if (byte != 'u' && byte != 'U' && byte != 'l' && byte != 'L')

008788:         }

008791:     for (u64 index = suffix_start; suffix_valid && !msvc_width && index < spelling.length;)
008792:     {
008793:         u8 byte = spelling.pointer[index];

008795:         {
008796:             if (is_unsigned)

008798:                 suffix_valid = false;
008799:             }

008803:         else
008804:         {

008806:             if (long_count || count > 2)
008807:             {
008808:                 suffix_valid = false;
008809:             }
008810:             long_count = count;
008811:             index += count;
008812:         }
008813:     }
008814:     CTypeKind candidates[6] = {0};
008815:     u32 candidate_count = 0;

008817:     if (suffix_valid)
008818:     {
008819:         if (msvc_width && msvc_width < 64)
008820:         {
008821:             CTypeKind signed_kind = msvc_width == 8 ? C_TYPE_SIGNED_CHAR : msvc_width == 16 ? C_TYPE_SHORT : C_TYPE_INT;
008822:             CTypeKind unsigned_kind = msvc_width == 8 ? C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_CHAR : msvc_width == 16 ? C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_SHORT : C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_INT;
008823:             C_INTEGER_LITERAL_CANDIDATE(is_unsigned ? unsigned_kind : signed_kind);
008824:         }

008831:             }

008833:             if (!decimal)
